title: Ruby security update: Critical fixes in versions 4.0.10, 3.4.13, and 3.3.14
partialText: Ruby security updates address seven vulnerabilities. Learn which versions are affected, what to upgrade, and how to keep your applications secure.

title: Friction worth protecting when shaping products
partialText: LLMs reduce friction in shaping and building products but a certain type of friction is critical for uncovering risky assumptions.

title: Modernising legacy systems in UK banking and financial services
partialText: Software modernisation in banking and finance goes beyond replacing old code. It’s about navigating a risk-averse environment to transform everything from processes to culture. Here’s what we’ve learned about making it all work.
